desc: Ideation: choose Cartesian-tree DP over DSU/priority-queue approaches.
Implement Cartesian-tree DP solution in Python with O(N) time, iterative traversal, and Python ints for sums.
Verify logic on samples and edge cases: all equal, monotone, equal blocks with smaller on one side, N=2, skewed trees, and cases where child subtree sum equals parent value.
